entities.name: Kairi
entities.description: A cool-headed spirit dragon of Kamigawa, reincarnation of Keiga, who frees Hidetsugu to fight the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Keiga
entities.description: Divine dragon of islands slain by Hidetsugu; Kairi is his reincarnation.

entities.name: Minamo
entities.description: Place Kairi protected until its decline late in the Shattered States Era.

entities.name: Otawara
entities.description: Rising center of learning and innovation that sought Kairi's protection.

entities.name: Moonfolk
entities.description: People Kairi suspected of ulterior intentions.

entities.name: Hidetsugu
entities.description: Demon locked in the spirit realm who slew Keiga and agrees to fight beside Kairi.

events.summary: Otawara seeks Kairi's protection but he suspects the moonfolk's intentions and refuses.
events.quote: Kairi was suspicious of the moonfolks ' intentions and refused

events.summary: Kairi frees Hidetsugu from the spirit realm and asks for help against the Phyrexians; Hidetsugu agrees.
events.quote: Hidetsugu agreed to fight alongside the dragon

relations.quote: He is the reincarnation of Keiga .
the reincarnation of the dragon he had slain

relations.note: temporary allies, Kairi plans to lock him up again
relations.quote: they're on the same side for the time being
